usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove a specific rule from a cluster-level firewall security group by its zero-based position index. Requires the `Sys.Modify` privilege at the root (`/`) path. Pass the `digest` parameter when scripting concurrent-safe deletions — it prevents accidental overwrites if the ruleset was modified between your read and this delete.

examples.summary: Delete the first rule (pos 0) from the security group 'webservers'

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the firewall rule at the specified position from the security group; all remaining rules shift up by one position and there is no undo.
tips: Rule positions are zero-based and shift after each deletion — re-read the group's rule list before deleting multiple rules in sequence.
Omitting `pos` from the path is technically allowed by the spec but will likely target rule 0; always specify the position explicitly to avoid unintended deletions.
Use `get_cluster_firewall_groups_group` to retrieve the current ruleset and its digest before calling this endpoint.
Returns null on success; any non-null response indicates an error.
